ms_text:
1 mark for each correct point
 •   Selecting the player’s name and counting a field
 •   Using an appropriate name
 •   Linking or joining the correct tables
 •
     Grouping the results
 •
     Ordering in descending order by player ID
 Example 1:
 SELECT PlayerName, COUNT(CHARACTER.CharacterID)  MP1
 AS TotalCharacters                                     MP2
 FROM CHARACTER, PLAYER
 WHERE CHARACTER.PlayerID = PLAYER.PlayerID        MP3
 GROUP BY PlayerName                                    MP4
 ORDER BY PLAYER.PlayerID DESC;                       MP5
 Example 2:
 SELECT PlayerName, COUNT(CharacterID)              MP1
 AS TotalCharacters                                     MP2
 FROM CHARACTER INNER JOIN PLAYER
 ON CHARACTER.PlayerID = PLAYER.PlayerID            MP3
 GROUP BY PlayerName                                    MP4
 ORDER BY PLAYER.PlayerID DESC;                       MP5
